segments.text: In the 1960s, many African countries gained their independence after long years of
segments.englishExplanation: Introduces the historic period in the 1960s when many African nations gained freedom.
segments.turkishExplanation: 1960'larda birçok Afrika ülkesi, uzun yıllar süren

segments.text: colonial rule. People celebrated in the streets, full of hope for the future.
segments.englishExplanation: Completes the sentence about colonial rule and describes the widespread public celebration.
segments.turkishExplanation: sömürge yönetiminin ardından bağımsızlığını kazandı. İnsanlar gelecek için umutla sokaklarda kutlama yaptı.

segments.englishExplanation: Points out that gaining freedom was accompanied by unexpected difficulties.
segments.turkishExplanation: Ancak özgürlük beraberinde yeni zorluklar getirdi.

segments.text: Many African countries did not know how to cope with their newly gained independence
segments.englishExplanation: Explains that nations struggled to manage their new status as independent states.
segments.turkishExplanation: Birçok Afrika ülkesi, yeni kazandığı bağımsızlıkla nasıl başa çıkacağını bilmiyordu

segments.text: because they had no experience in administrating and governing a nation.
segments.englishExplanation: Gives the reason for their struggle: lack of practical experience in running a country.
segments.turkishExplanation: çünkü bir devleti yönetme ve idare etme konusunda hiçbir deneyimleri yoktu.

segments.text: For decades, outsiders had made all the important decisions.
segments.englishExplanation: Notes that foreign powers had taken all major decisions for decades prior to independence.
segments.turkishExplanation: On yıllar boyunca tüm önemli kararları yabancılar almıştı.

segments.text: Suddenly, new leaders had to build schools, courts and economies, almost from scratch.
segments.englishExplanation: Describes how new leaders had to build state institutions completely from nothing.
segments.turkishExplanation: Aniden, yeni liderler neredeyse sıfırdan okullar, mahkemeler ve ekonomiler inşa etmek zorunda kaldı.

segments.text: Some countries learned quickly, while others struggled for many years.
segments.englishExplanation: Contrasts countries that adapted quickly with those that faced long-term difficulties.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazı ülkeler çabuk öğrenirken, diğerleri uzun yıllar zorlandı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to describe dealing successfully with a difficult situation or environment.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Zor bir durum veya sorumlulukla başarıyla mücadele etmek veya başa çıkmak anlamında kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: It took time for the company to cope with the sudden growth.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Şirketin ani büyümeyle başa çıkması zaman aldı.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Means starting something from the very beginning without using anything that already exists.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Önceden var olan hiçbir şeyi kullanmadan, tamamen en baştan veya sıfırdan başlamak anlamına gelir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: After losing all data, they had to rebuild the project from scratch.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Tüm verileri kaybettikten sonra projeyi sıfırdan yeniden kurmak zorunda kaldılar.

quiz.question: Many African countries did not know how to cope with their newly gained independence because they had no experience ______ administrating and governing a nation.
